Silo spec.runtime="kvm"
  Silo s: spec.runtime must be one of cloud-hypervisor, openshell, docker, podman, openshell-container
Silo spec.resources={"cpu":-1}
  Silo s: spec.resources.cpu can't be negative
Silo spec.tolerations=[{"key":""}]
  Silo s: every toleration needs a key
Silo spec.tolerations=[{"key":"k","effect":"NoExecute"}]
  Silo s: toleration effect must be NoSchedule or PreferNoSchedule
Silo spec.init={"steps":[]}
  Silo s: every init step needs a name and something to run
Silo spec.init={"when":"daily","steps":[{"name":"a","run":"true"}]}
  Silo s: init.when must be firstBoot or everyBoot
Silo spec.init={"steps":[{"name":"a","run":"x"},{"name":"a","run":"y"}]}
  Silo s: init step names must be unique
Silo spec.availability={"onHostLoss":"Pray"}
  Silo s: availability.onHostLoss must be Wait, Recreate or Move
Silo spec.network={"egress":{"source":"gateway"}}
  Silo s: network.egress.source must be host, sameAsService or pool (gateway comes later)
Silo spec.network={"egress":{"ip":"x"}}
  Silo s: egress.ip goes with egress.source: pool
Silo spec.volumes=[{"name":"Data","mountPath":"/d"}]
  Silo s: every volume needs a name (lower-case letters, digits, -), an absolute mountPath, and a class: local, or a plugin's (e.g. linode-block)
Silo spec.volumes=[{"name":"d","class":"linode-block","mountPath":"/d"}]
  Silo s: a volume on a plugin's storage class needs a size (e.g. 10Gi)
Silo spec.volumes=[{"name":"d","mountPath":"/a"},{"name":"d","mountPath":"/b"}]
  Silo s: volume names must be unique
Silo spec.update={"strategy":"Yolo"}
  Silo s: update.strategy must be StopFirst or StartFirst
Silo spec.update={"strategy":"StartFirst"}
  Silo s: update.strategy StartFirst on a single silo needs its disk cloned, which comes with moves (M14); use StopFirst, or a SiloSet, whose update.strategy StartFirst starts extra instances first
Silo spec.exclusive=true spec.availability={"onHostLoss":"Move"}
  Silo s: exclusive: true forbids automatic failover: onHostLoss must be Wait (a move is manual, once the old copy is provably stopped)
Silo spec.daemons=[{"name":"d","run":"x","restart":"sometimes"}]
  Silo s: every daemon needs a name (lower-case letters, digits, -), something to run, and restart: always, onFailure or never
Silo spec.daemons=[{"name":"d","run":"x"},{"name":"d","run":"y"}]
  Silo s: daemon names must be unique
Silo spec.upkeep=[{"name":"u","every":"6h","check":"true","fix":""}]
  Silo s: every upkeep task needs a name, every (e.g. 6h), a check and a fix
Silo spec.upkeep=[{"name":"u","every":"6h","check":"c","fix":"f"},{"name":"u","every":"6h","check":"c","fix":"f"}]
  Silo s: upkeep names must be unique
Silo spec.upkeep=[{"name":"u","every":"10s","check":"c","fix":"f"}]
  Silo s: upkeep u: every "10s": want a duration of at least 1m (e.g. 6h)
Silo spec.panes={"allow":["js"],"http":{"port":8080}}
  Silo s: panes.allow: status, html
Silo spec.panes={"maxPanes":17,"http":{"port":8080}}
  Silo s: panes.maxPanes: 0 to 16
Silo spec.panes={"maxPanes":1}
  Silo s: panes needs http.port (1 to 65535): where the silo answers its host's pane requests; without spec.panes there are none
Silo spec.panes={"http":{"port":8080,"path":"/x?y"}}
  Silo s: panes.http.path: an absolute path (starting with /), no query, at most 200 characters
Silo spec.container.pull={"secretRef":""}
  Silo s: container.pull needs secretRef: a registry secret in the namespace
Silo spec.placement={"spread":{"by":"rack","selector":{"a":"b"}}}
  Silo s: placement.spread needs by (host, zone or region) and a selector
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"Web","port":80}]
  Silo s: spec.ports: "Web": a port needs a name (lower-case letters, digits, -)
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80},{"name":"web","port":81}]
  Silo s: spec.ports: web is declared twice
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":0}]
  Silo s: spec.ports[web]: port 0 isn't from 1 to 65535
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80,"protocol":"SCTP"}]
  Silo s: spec.ports[web]: protocol "SCTP": TCP or UDP
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"a","port":80},{"name":"b","port":80}]
  Silo s: spec.ports: a and b are both 80/TCP
Silo spec.network={"egress":{"source":"sameAsService"}}
  Silo s: network.egress.source sameAsService needs a service with a port on the host or a load balancer: there's no address in to send from otherwise
Silo spec.service={"name":"Api"}
  Silo s: service.name "Api": lower-case letters, digits and -, at most 63
Silo spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web"}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web]: "web" isn't a declared port (spec.ports): declare it first
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web"},{"port":"web"}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web]: opened twice: put everything about one port in one entry
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","allowFrom":["a/b/c"]}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web].allowFrom: "a/b/c": a silo, NAME or NAMESPACE/NAME
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","allowFrom":["10.0.0.0/8"]}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web].allowFrom: "10.0.0.0/8" is a network range: allowFrom names silos; ranges go in sources (with hostPort or loadBalancer)
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","hostPort":["public"]}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web].hostPort: "public": internal or external
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","hostPort":["external","external"]}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web].hostPort: external twice; service.ports[web]: 80/TCP on the external IP is web's already
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","as":443}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web].as: only with hostPort or loadBalancer (it's the number there)
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","sources":["10.0.0.0/8"]}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web].sources: only with hostPort or loadBalancer (who may connect on its silo IP is allowFrom)
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","hostPort":["external"],"as":70000}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web].as: 70000 isn't from 1 to 65535
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","hostPort":["external"],"sources":["10.0.0.0/33"]}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[web].sources: "10.0.0.0/33" isn't an address or CIDR
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"a","port":80},{"name":"b","port":81}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"a","hostPort":["external"],"as":443},{"port":"b","hostPort":["external"],"as":443}]}
  Silo s: service.ports[b]: 443/TCP on the external IP is a's already
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","loadBalancer":true}]}
  Silo s: a port with loadBalancer: true needs service.loadBalancer.class: ip-pool, or a plugin's class (e.g. linode-nodebalancer)
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web"}],"loadBalancer":{"class":"ip-pool"}}
  Silo s: service.loadBalancer is where ports with loadBalancer: true get their address, and no port says so
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","loadBalancer":true}],"loadBalancer":{"class":"ip-pool","ip":"x","dedicated":true}}
  Silo s: service.loadBalancer.dedicated asks for an IP made for it alone: not with loadBalancer.ip (that one is named already)
Silo spec.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.service={"ports":[{"port":"web"}]} spec.network={"egress":{"source":"sameAsService"}}
  Silo s: network.egress.source sameAsService needs a port on the host or a load balancer: there's no address in to send from otherwise
Silo spec.network={"egress":{"source":"pool"}}
  Silo s: network.egress.source pool needs egress.ip: an IP of class ip-pool (or ports on a load balancer of class ip-pool, whose IP it then sends from)
VMImage spec.versions=[]
  VMImage u: a VMImage needs at least one version
VMImage spec.versions.0.name="-v"
  VMImage u: every version needs a name (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-')

  VMImage u: version names must be unique
VMImage spec.versions.0.disk!
  VMImage u: every version is a bootable disk (url and sha256): VMImages are disks for cloud-hypervisor; a container silo names a registry reference in container.image instead
VMImage spec.versions.0.disk.url="http://example.com/u.img"
  VMImage u: a disk needs an https:// url and its sha256 (64 hex digits): hosts check what they fetch
SiloSet spec.instances=-1

  SiloSet set: update.maxUnavailable and update.maxSurge can't be negative

  SiloSet set: exclusive instances update one at a time, stop-first: never two copies, so no StartFirst or maxSurge
SiloSet spec.template.labels={"kevaso.com/set":"x"}
  SiloSet set: template.labels can't use kevaso.com/ labels: the set sets those
SiloSet metadata.name="aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
  SiloSet aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa: a SiloSet's name is at most 56 characters (its instances add -N)
SiloSet spec.template.ports=[{"name":"web","port":80}] spec.template.service={"ports":[{"port":"web","loadBalancer":true}],"loadBalancer":{"class":"ip-pool","ip":"x"}}
  SiloSet set: template.service.loadBalancer.ip would put every instance on one IP with the same ports, which clash: leave it out and each instance gets one of its own (or put the set behind a Service, which can name one)
SiloSet spec.template.service={"name":"api"}
  SiloSet set: template.service.name would give every instance the same name, and a name has one owner: each instance's service is named after it (api-0, api-1…); put a Service in front for one name
SiloSet spec.template.network={"egress":{"source":"pool","ip":"x"}}
  SiloSet set: template.network.egress.ip would give every instance the same IP, which serves one silo
SiloSet spec.template.runtime="kvm"
  SiloSet set: template: spec.runtime must be one of cloud-hypervisor, openshell, docker, podman, openshell-container

Secret spec.type="rsa"
  Secret k: spec.type must be opaque, ed25519, ecdsa-p256 or registry
Secret spec.type="registry"
  Secret k: a registry secret needs spec.server (the registry host, e.g. ghcr.io) and spec.username; its value is the password or token
Secret spec.server="ghcr.io"
  Secret k: spec.server and spec.username are for type: registry
Secret spec.type="registry" spec.server="ghcr.io" spec.username="bot" spec.allowedDelivery=["env"]
  Secret k: a registry secret is never delivered to a silo (only a host's agent gets it, for a pull) and isn't generated: drop allowedDelivery and generate
Secret metadata.labels={"kevaso.com/default-pull":"true"}
  Secret k: kevaso.com/default-pull: "true", on a registry secret only (it makes it the namespace's pull secret for its server)
Secret spec.allowedDelivery=["email"]
  Secret k: spec.allowedDelivery: broker, inject, file, env or sign
Secret spec.type="ed25519" spec.valueReadable=true
  Secret k: a signing key is never readable: drop valueReadable
Secret spec.type="ed25519" spec.allowedDelivery=["env"]
  Secret k: a signing key is only used through sign: allowedDelivery can only be [sign]
Secret spec.generate=true spec.value="eA=="
  Secret k: spec.generate and spec.value don't go together: the server makes the value
Secret spec.value="AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA…
  Secret k: spec.value: at most 64 KiB

  Grant g: a grant needs egress, secrets or operations

Grant spec.secrets=[{"name":"k","to":{"host":"a.example.com"}}]

Grant spec.secrets=[{"name":"k","path":"/run/k"}]
  Grant g: path goes with deliver: file
Grant spec.secrets=[{"name":"k","env":"K"}]

Grant spec.operations={"sign":{"keyRef":""}}

Grant spec.secrets=[{"name":"k","deliver":"file","path":"/run/k","approval":{"required":true}}]
  Grant g: approval works with deliver: broker or inject (and operations.sign): once a value sits in a file or an env var, nothing can ask again
Grant spec.egress=[{"to":"not a host"}]
  Grant g: egress "not a host": not a CIDR, an address or a host name
Grant spec.secrets=[{"name":"k","deliver":"inject","to":{"host":"*.example.com"}}]

Grant spec.secrets=[{"name":"k","deliver":"inject","to":{"host":"a.example.com","format":"Bearer"}}]

Grant spec.secrets=[{"name":"k","deliver":"inject","to":{"host":"a.example.com","header":"X: y"}}]

Grant spec.secrets=[{"name":"k","deliver":"file","path":"/etc/k"}]
  Grant g: secret k: path "/etc/k" must be under /run/ (tmpfs: a secret file never reaches the silo's disk), without ..

IP spec.class="Pool"

Host spec.internalIP!
  Host h: a host needs spec.internalIP (its address on its own network), spec.externalIP (its address reachable from outside it), or both
Host spec.components={}
  Host h: a host needs at least one component: controlPlane or worker

  Host h: every taint needs a key and an effect of NoSchedule or PreferNoSchedule (there's no NoExecute: silos are stateful)

  Host h: unknown runtime in spec.components.worker.runtimes

Host spec.externalIP="10.0.0.5"

  Host h: spec.network.dns: "mesh": internal or external (silos and the mesh are always answered)
Host spec.network={"dns":["external"]}
  Host h: spec.network.dns: external: the host has no external IP
Host spec.network={"addresses":["nope"]}
  Host h: spec.network.addresses: "nope" isn't an address or CIDR
Namespace metadata.name="mesh"
  Namespace mesh: "mesh" is a network's name (mesh, internal, external), which names use as a label of their own: pick another

  Namespace internal: "internal" is a network's name (mesh, internal, external), which names use as a label of their own: pick another
Namespace metadata.name="external"
  Namespace external: "external" is a network's name (mesh, internal, external), which names use as a label of their own: pick another
